intent: Record as reviewed the finding, note, report, proposal and agent run rules the operations Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context operations lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A new sighting reopens a closed finding only when it was last seen within 30 days; after that it opens a new finding.
An operator's note on an agent change is at most the contract's cap counted in characters; one more is refused with 400.
A daily report with no items is rejected.
A report's proposal is rejected unless a fact a tool returned offers the action it names.
A proposed action waits 24 hours for a decision and then lapses.
A proposal still running two hours after it started is failed as abandoned; one inside the lease keeps running.
Releasing the brake when none is engaged succeeds without recording a brake-released audit event.
Starting a run for a disabled, unknown or braked agent is refused as halted and records no run.
A run that has finished cannot take another step.
A maintenance job that fails with a blank message closes its proposal as failed with an outcome saying it failed without saying why.
